Qwen.name: qwen3-embedding:0.6b
Qwen.query_instruction: Given a technical query about inkjet printheads, retrieve patent passages describing the relevant technical object, problem and solution.

code_changes_after_freeze: Quote auditing, completed-stage reuse, artifact assembly and reports; no labels, vectors or algorithm parameters changed.

quote_audit.note: Independent audit fixes only overly conservative cross-theme propagation of panel errors; it never promotes fewer than 3 valid families or changes any model name/cluster. Exact-source matching is not semantic entailment or expert validation.

posthoc_amendment.criterion: Two K800 clusters containing most historical Recipe observed families; finer already-completed partition compared with broad modal communities.

limitations: Clusters mix object, application, material and mechanism levels.
PCA changes neighborhood structure; HDBSCAN Noise is not irrelevance.
Literal quotes do not prove common mechanisms; 15 named candidates are not 15 validated routes.
Historical labels only used after first naming freeze; post-hoc blind results are not first-pass discoveries.
